citations.claim: E turned green at step 51 with 0s all-red while emergency active, EW green phase
One step before, E was red and NS was yellow, so no all-red elapsed

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event at t=51; same steps and timings. No violation, showing emergency preemption caused the skipped all-red.

explanation: Emergency preemption at t=51 forced EW green immediately from NS yellow, skipping the required 1s all-red clearance. Step 50 shows NS yellow with E red; step 51 shows E/W green with emergency active, i.e. 0s of all-red.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 1 s)

vision_note: Step 50 shows yellow for the N-S direction with E-W held at red. Step 51 shows E-W turning green immediately with no intervening all-red clearance interval.
